decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of the development a description of the steps and works to be taken and carried out in relation to the repair and alteration of the existing timber frame, including any additional elements to be inserted, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing and the development shall thereafter be undertaken in accordance with the approved scheme.

Condition : 6 - A sample panel of render to be used on the external surface of the building, showing the composition, texture, finished colour and surface details shall be prepared on site and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to application to the building.
Condition : 7 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the building.
description: Internal alterations to provide an ensuite to master bedroom, kitchen and family room rearrangement and an under-stair toilet; and repairs and structural defects.
